static_findings.message: An input-derived URL is used as a link target after a scheme check; verify that only http and https pass.

security_requirements: The link must not carry a javascript:, data: or vbscript: URL.
Neither argument may add an element or an event-handler attribute.
label: not_vulnerable
reason: Allows only http/https schemes and html.escape(quote=True) both arguments. Scheme-less URLs are allowed; leading control characters are caught only because Python 3.11.4+ urlsplit strips them.
how_checked: code review + 16 scheme-bypass and attribute-injection payloads
